relationships.fc_property: The property by which independently applicable biospheric-continuity, planetary life-support, ecological-integrity, irreversible-harm and future-generations constraints remain governing admissibility conditions rather than expendable objective costs, subject only to separately established and independently sufficient authority, necessity or other permitted trade-off bases.
relationships.invariant: Where biospheric continuity, planetary life-support, ecological integrity, irreversible-harm limits or conditions necessary for future generations are applicable constraints on a decision or action space, objective utility must remain subordinate to those constraints unless a separately established and independently sufficient authority or necessity basis permits the affected trade-off. Ecological continuity constraints must not silently collapse into soft costs, tunable preferences or expendable resources merely because doing so improves task performance.

entries.rationale: Reserved-prefix avoidance reduces BOM-Link reference collisions. The SHOULD is not schema-enforced and does not require stable binding across contexts.
